title: feat(mail): mailbox hierarchy — News/*, List/*, special-use, RFC 6154
description:
Users connecting via IMAP or JMAP see a flat list of newsgroup names at the mailbox root with no recognizable structure. Standard email clients cannot navigate this. This epic implements the full three-tree mailbox hierarchy that makes stoa usable as a primary email client.

Target structure:
- INBOX, Sent, Drafts, Trash, Junk, Archive — personal email, RFC 6154 special-use flags
- List/<list-name> — mailing list traffic, auto-created per List-Id: header
- News/<group-name> — Usenet newsgroups (e.g. News/comp.lang.rust)

Why this exists: without this structure, a user cannot read email through any standard client. The INBOX provisioning (n1z4.1–3) delivers messages; this epic provides the folder structure and routing that puts them in the right place.

Child issues cover: News/* prefix and NAMESPACE delimiter change, RFC 6154 special-use IMAP flags, List/* auto-creation, Sieve routing rule, and IMAP LIST hierarchy flags.
